host.description: Hostname for external access via Ingress. Leave empty to skip Ingress.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the persistent volume. Leave empty to use cluster default.

computePlane.description: Deploy the workload onto the tenant's ComputePlane (requires the computeplane tenant module, cozystack >= the release shipping it). When false, the app runs co-located in the tenant namespace on the management cluster.

size.description: PVC size. Stable Diffusion checkpoints range from 2GB (SD 1.5) to 12GB+ (SDXL/Flux); 50Gi fits ~4-6 models plus outputs.

gpuEnabled.description: Enable GPU acceleration. Set to false for CPU-only mode (very slow, for testing only).

gpuCount.description: Number of GPUs allocated to the pod.

replicaCount.description: Number of ComfyUI pods. Usually 1 — ComfyUI is stateful and multiple replicas do not share workflow state.
